info.title: Heroes Profile API
info.description: Heroes of the Storm statistics, replay data, talent builds and player profiles.

apiKey.description: An API key from your account page, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

get.summary: Which team compositions win, and how often.

parameters.name: timeframe_type
parameters.description: How `timeframe` is read. `minor` is a build, `major` a patch.

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: One patch or build, or several comma-separated. Not required when `timeframe_type` is `last_update`.

parameters.name: game_type
parameters.description: Game type, by short name or display name — `sl` and `Storm League` both work, case-insensitive. Comma-separated for several.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region, by name or id — `NA` and `1` both work. NA/1, EU/2, KR/3, CN/5.

parameters.name: hero
parameters.description: Hero name.

parameters.name: game_map
parameters.description: Map name.

parameters.name: hero_level
parameters.description: Hero level band, not a level. One of the band codes — see Variables.

parameters.name: league_tier
parameters.description: Player league tier id.

parameters.name: hero_league_tier
parameters.description: Hero league tier id.

parameters.name: role_league_tier
parameters.description: Role league tier id.

parameters.name: mirror
parameters.description: Include mirror matches.

parameters.name: group_by_map
parameters.description: Report one result set per playable map rather than one across all of them, keyed by map name. Answers with a job id like any other global query, and counts as one call however many maps it covers — a multiplier may be applied later if that turns out to be abused.

parameters.name: minimum_games
parameters.description: Drop compositions below this many games. Defaults to 100.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Response format. `csv` returns the same data as a downloadable file, flattened to one row per record.

popularity.description: Percentage of matches in which this appeared, 0 to 100.

202.description: The result was not cached. Poll the job for it — polling costs no quota.

get.x-rate-limit: The usual 60 requests a minute, dropping to 1 when `group_by_map=true` — that form runs a query per playable map.

get.summary: Every hero, most played builds, in one call. Takes the same filters as `heroes/talents/builds` and answers one entry per hero — several game types are one query, not separate groupings. A hero whose query cannot be completed answers with `{"error": "..."}` in place of its builds rather than failing the whole set.

parameters.description: How `timeframe` is read. `minor` is a build, `major` a patch. Defaults to the site's own current timeframe.

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: One patch or build, or several comma-separated. Defaults to the current patch.

parameters.name: game_type
parameters.description: Game type, by short name or display name — `sl` and `Storm League` both work, case-insensitive. Comma-separated for several, which are counted together rather than reported apart. Defaults to `qm,sl,ar`.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region, by name or id — `NA` and `1` both work. NA/1, EU/2, KR/3, CN/5.

parameters.description: Include mirror matches.

parameters.description: Which ranking decides the builds returned. Defaults to `Popular`.

parameters.name: total_builds
parameters.description: How many builds to return per hero, 1 to 25. Defaults to 7.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Response format. `csv` returns the same data as a downloadable file, flattened to one row per record.
